vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: series-storytelling-skill
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle is a specialized creative writing tool designed to assist an AI agent in structuring long-form story outlines and scripts. All files, including SKILL.md and the templates in the /templates and /examples directories, consist of markdown instructions and organizational frameworks for storytelling (e.g., character arcs, episode SOPs, and plot progression). There is no executable code, no network activity, and no evidence of malicious prompt injection or data exfiltration attempts.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions and included templates match its storytelling purpose, but the manifest sets always:true (force-included) without justification, which is disproportionate and worth caution.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and all files (SKILL.md, templates, examples, references) are consistent with a long-form series/season outlining skill; no unrelated binaries, env vars, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are explicit about inputs to collect and point to local templates under {baseDir}; they do not instruct reading arbitrary system files, accessing external unknown endpoints, or exfiltrating data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only with no install spec and no code files to execute. No downloads or archive extraction are declared.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths — the declared requirements are proportional to the stated function.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The registry metadata sets always:true (and the SKILL.md metadata repeats always:true). always:true forces the skill to be included in every agent run and increases its attack surface; the skill provides no justification for this elevated persistence, which is disproportionate for a storytelling helper.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for story/season outlining and includes helpful templates and examples, but the manifest sets always:true (force-enabled) with no clear reason. Before installing, ask the publisher why the skill must be always-enabled. If you do not need it on every agent run, disable or remove the always:true flag. Also verify the upstream repository (homepage) and owner identity, and monitor agent activity after enabling (audit which prompts trigger the skill and what data it sees). Because it's instruction-only and requests no credentials, the immediate technical risk is low — the main concern is the unnecessary persistence privilege which increases exposure if the skill were ever updated maliciously.
